verdict.rationale: Fast mode documents a `language_detection` request parameter that detects the input language either once or continuously, so developers need not declare the language. That detection applies across a documented multilingual model set of ten languages plus 26 Whisper locales. Missing for 10: evidence that detection works in Live and Batch modes, documentation of how the detected language is reported in responses and which languages it covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of detection accuracy.
